help.text: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

shortDescription.text: Workflow installs dependencies without caching configured.

help.text: Enable built-in caching on setup-* actions (e.g., cache: 'pip' or 'npm') or add an explicit actions/cache step.

message.text: CRITICAL: Job 'publish' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).

message.text: Job 'publish' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

properties.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

message.text: MEDIUM: Workflow installs dependencies without 'actions/cache' or setup action caching.

properties.remediation: Enable built-in caching on setup-* actions (e.g., cache: 'pip' or 'npm') or add an explicit actions/cache step.
